name: team-workbench
description: Team workspace with lead-orchestrated execution and reported session browsing.

interface.shortDescription: Tasks and team in one place
interface.longDescription: Team tasks, multilevel recorded agents, workflow groups and visible conversation pages. The lead reads its authorized parent activities; deterministic MCP code binds exact agent paths to unique thread IDs and returns the child-read request. Host reads are lead-mediated, source-labeled and bounded. Missing tools/history are explicit blockers. No hidden discovery, native navigation or full transcript claim.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Team Workbench for this task.
